criteria.evidence: idea-board.tsx now reads `pinned`/`togglePin` from useSessionStore and removed the `useState<Set<string>>` pinnedIds; PinnedRef imported from stores/session.
handleTogglePin builds `{ id, title, lane, imageUrl: null, sourceUrl: null }` and calls the store's togglePin — one pin path reusable with a real URL.
Label `{pins.length} pins · conditioning input`, thumbs left, Generate right; thumbs ended at 40px rather than ~48 but close enough for a judge call (CSS not visible in truncated diff).
Single `generate-button` rendered after the thumbs group in pin-rail.tsx.
`if (pins.length === 0) { return null }`.
Rail uses className 'pin-rail workspace-enter'; no motion dependency appears in the diff.

`@router.post('/v1/generate', response_model=GenerateResponse)` with GenerateRequest{session_id, transcript, pins} and GenerateResponse{image_url, prompt, model, reference_count} as StrictModel Pydantic models.

Route hardcodes `intent = None` with a TODO so the VisualIntent never reaches synthesis; ImagePrompt only has per-field char limits and no word-count validator, so an >80-word prompt is not a validation error.
Only `prompt_text` (flattened ImagePrompt) is placed in fal `arguments`; transcript never passed to _generate_with_fal.
POST to `https://queue.fal.run/{model_id}` with header `X-Fal-Store-IO: 0`, then `_poll_fal` GETs `/requests/{id}`; no webhook.
fal_request_timeout_seconds=45 caps the poll loop; expiry raises GenerationFailed('fal_timeout') returned as a typed problem with code fal_timeout.
Submit is a single `client.post`; httpx.HTTPError on submit raises immediately, no retry loop around it.
OpenAI call wrapped in asyncio.wait_for(openai_request_timeout_seconds); httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=45) covers submit and poll.
fal reached via plain httpx; openai SDK already used elsewhere in repo; no pyproject/uv.lock change shown.
model_id = fal_reference_model if image_urls else fal_fallback_model; URLs capped at fal_max_reference_images and sent as `image_urls`.
Pin titles always included in synthesis user_message; reference_count=len(public_urls)=0 for stickers; frontend only shows references when >0.
GenerateClient._in_flight dict; second request raises GenerationInProgress → 409 `generation_in_progress`.
config.py adds fal_key, fal_reference_model='fal-ai/flux-pro/kontext/max/multi', fal_fallback_model='fal-ai/flux/schnell', fal_max_reference_images=4 matching .env.example.
demo_mode=='fixture' short-circuits both _synthesise and _generate_with_fal with canned values before any network client is created.
GenerateResult renders img then `.result-prompt` {prompt}, `.meta-model` {model} and reference count (when >0); model reports it occupies the workpane.
Rail is a persistent bottom banner driven by store `pinned`; model confirms 'Pin rail stays visible after generation'.
PinRail only takes `isGenerating`; no error prop, no one-line error with correlation id rendered by the button — error state is not implemented in the rail.
Model grepped dist: 'No secrets in the bundle'; OpenAI and fal calls live in apps/api/glia/generate.py.
Model reports pnpm typecheck/lint/build, uv run mypy . and ruff check . passing on the branch.
New TSX uses typed props (`className?: string | undefined`), no `any` or `!` visible.
generate.py catches only specific exceptions (httpx.HTTPError, APIError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError).
Diff touches no README.md or docs/ files.
test_api.py adjusted to pin DEMO_MODE=fixture for the websocket test, consistent with the suite having been run; no other test regressions shown.
Turn 1: 'Pin rail moved to bottom as a persistent light banner (below the mic button)'.
Turn 1: light neutral background `rgb(249 249 249)` banner.
Each pin-thumb has a `thumb-unpin` button with lucide `<X size={14} />` calling onUnpin(pin.id), always visible.
Local `git merge` produced merge commit ca59006 on main; no remote available, so local landing is the most achievable step.

judge.reason: The replay delivered most of the pipeline, the bottom banner, X unpin icons and a local merge to main, but the synthesis step never receives the VisualIntent (hardcoded `intent = None` with a TODO) and the ImagePrompt schema has no under-80-word enforcement, failing c4. The Generate button also lacks the required error state with a correlation id (c26), so the verdict is fail.
